home_intro: A browsable map of identifiers, registration agencies, indices, institutional systems, standards and communities in open science, and of how they relate to each other.
home_map_placeholder_title: The interactive map is being rebuilt
home_map_placeholder_body: Meanwhile, the glossary lists every entry and the questions offer guided paths through the graph.
glossary_intro: Every entry on the map, A to Z, with its type and a one-sentence definition.
questions_intro: Short answers to questions about how the ecosystem is organised, built from the same graph as the map and the glossary.
question_fallback_notice: This question is not yet translated into English; showing the Spanish original.
questions_stories_intro: Each path answers one question in a few steps, from one entry to the next.
story_map_soon: Soon this path can be followed step by step on the map. For now, the steps read as a list.
entity_no_relations: This entry has no recorded relationships yet.
entity_fallback_notice: This entry is not yet translated into English; showing the Spanish original.
about_scope_body: A knowledge explorer of the research-information ecosystem: identifiers, registration agencies, indices, institutional systems, standards, communities and coalitions. It currently holds {entities} entries and {relations} relationships.
about_scope_not: The site is read-only. It does not assess or score services.
about_inclusion_body: An entry is included when it has a stable public URL, when another entry in the graph refers to it or it is a recognised registry, standards body or coalition, and when it is not a single project's internal tooling.
about_policy_one_place: One fact, one place: derived facts (inverse relations, layers, totals) are computed, never written by hand.
about_policy_canonical: Every relationship is written once, in its canonical direction.
about_policy_descriptive: Descriptive, not evaluative: no quality adjectives.
about_policy_sources: Provenance required: every entry cites at least one source with an access date.
about_policy_freshness: Freshness tracked: every entry records when it was last reviewed.
about_reading_nodes: Each dot is an entry: a concept, an identifier, a service, a rule or an organisation. Each line is a directed relationship that reads as a sentence: "Crossref issues DOI".
about_reading_families: Relationships fall into {count} families, which the map and the entry pages use to order what they show:
about_model_intro: These tables are generated from the repository vocabularies (vocab/entity-types.yaml and vocab/predicates.yaml), so they cannot drift from the rules applied when the data is validated.
about_downloads_intro: The complete data is published under CC-BY-4.0 in open formats:
download_graph: Full graph with texts in every language (JSON)
download_entity_json: Each entry on its own as JSON, for example:
download_feed: RSS feed of recently reviewed entries
about_changelog_body: Changes to the data and to the site are recorded in the changelog.
not_found_body: This page does not exist, or the link is out of date.
map_canvas_label: Interactive map: open science concepts and services
map_hint: Tap a point to see what it connects to.
map_keys_help: Keyboard: / searches, arrow keys move between points, Enter opens or shows more, Esc goes back.
